title: Hunch: your Mac, working in the background
excerpt: A free macOS agent that works across your real apps while you keep using your Mac.
content_html:
Free and Open Source

Hunch is a computer use agent that uses your Mac in the background to do your tasks. Ask from the menu bar, keep working, and stay in control.

Requires a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer). Free to download and use with your existing Claude or ChatGPT/Codex subscription—Hunch adds no usage fee or metered API bill.

Hunch is your new AI assistant that lives on your Mac

Hunch can work with native apps, websites, files, developer tools, and saved logins in the same task.

“Log in to Quercus using my U of T credentials. Go to CSCC63, download all the tutorial and past final exam PDFs, and move them to the C63 folder in Downloads. After that, open C63 in Cursor, start the Codex CLI in the terminal, and ask Codex to generate practice final exams for me.”
“In iMovie, add text over the second clip that says ‘Hunch working in the background.’ For the third clip, add text that says ‘Hunch performing a series of AppleScript commands to retrieve the credentials and add them to Vercel.’”
“Go to Codex and open the Hunch MCP section. There should be a conversation about counting the number of Hunch downloads. Review the conversation and complete the steps shown in: ‘One step left for the counter to increment: add these production environment variables to the Vercel project using the same values as your local rclone R2 remote, then redeploy.’”
“In Downloads, create a folder named Hunch and move the video ‘Hunch Demo 1’ into it.”

One agent for your whole Mac.

Give Hunch the outcome. It can cross app boundaries and finish the steps that normally interrupt your flow.

⌘

Mac apps

Use the apps already on your Mac.

Work in Finder, Mail, Notes, Calendar, iMovie, Music, and other native apps through direct system interfaces.

◎

Browser

Work inside your logged-in websites.

Research, download, organize, and complete browser workflows using the sessions already available on your Mac.

↳

Files

Turn messy folders into finished work.

Create folders, rename files, sort downloads, open projects, and move material between apps without manual cleanup.

›_

Developer tools

Continue the task in Cursor or Codex.

Open repositories, inspect issues, prepare notes, and hand work to a coding agent without losing the original context.

◇

Saved access

Your credentials stay on your Mac.

Hunch stores saved logins, API keys, and tokens in macOS Keychain. It can use them locally when a task requires access, but secret values are never displayed to the AI.

  • Credential values do not appear in the task conversation.
  • Review or delete saved access from Hunch at any time.
  • Keep sending, publishing, and external actions approval-gated.

Read the full security model →

✓

Multi-step work

Chain actions across apps with clear limits.

Give one request, continue with follow-ups, and keep external or disruptive actions behind your approval rules.

Three steps, then ask Hunch.

Connect your AI subscription, choose how Hunch may work, and optionally save the access your tasks need.

01

Sign in

Choose Claude or ChatGPT/Codex. Your existing subscription powers Hunch, so there is no separate Hunch usage bill.

02

Choose permissions

Enable the macOS permissions Hunch needs, then decide which actions can run directly and which should ask first.

03

Add credentials

Optionally save logins or API keys in macOS Keychain for tasks that need authenticated access.

How Hunch works

Hunch chooses the most direct interface available. Screenshots and cursor control are the fallback, not the default.

01OS APIsFiles, clipboard, apps, and lifecycle operations.focus-free

02AppleScriptNative automation for scriptable apps.focus-free

03Web · Chrome DevToolsReal logged-in browser and Electron sessions.focus-free

04Accessibility treeRead and act on native app controls in the background.focus-free

05Vision: screenshot + clickOnly when no structured interface exists; always gated.approval

Download Hunch for macOS

Use your existing Claude or ChatGPT/Codex subscription. Hunch adds no subscription or metered API bill.

Requires a Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer). Start with ⌥ Space.

Less screen disturbance.

In our benchmark, Hunch ran the same tasks with the same model while tracking foreground changes and cursor movement—the dimension virtual-machine benchmarks cannot see.
